categories.name: Admission Non-Critical (NC)
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a non-critical inpatient ward, contributing to the standard inpatient care pathway. It is measured against discharge and readmission indicators and affects the softgoal of avoiding post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared OR alternative Admission NC (id=15) based on the goal model decomposition. The narrative sample shows this alternative realized in standard inpatient ward admissions (e.g., variant V0008), supporting recovery without intensive care requirements.

categories.name: Admission Intensive Care (IC)
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward. It connects to the softgoal to minimize time-to-treatment via a negative contribution (-25) due to resource-intensive transfers, and performance is evaluated against post-discharge outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared OR alternative Admission IC (id=16) from the goal model. The narrative sample confirms its realization in severe patient pathways requiring intensive care monitoring (e.g., variant V0605 and V0317), reflecting the organization's critical care track.
